changes.title: Travel path prep
items: Island paths and ground heights can be prepared while you sail.

changes.title: Travel ground extras
items: Ground preparation leaves out details absent from the island.

changes.title: Pause input stack
items: Keys held while pausing no longer carry into play when you resume.
The pause menu recognises Back reliably when reopened between frames.

changes.title: Save slots
items: Keep separate progress and settings in save slots, and switch or start a fresh save from Settings → Saves.
Saved nights can continue after a game update when their save format is compatible.
